text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(The 'Japanese Derby'... A fine day for 
it. Thanks to that, I have no doubts at 
all~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. We have managed to undergo ideal 
training up to this point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Even while chasing Lady Ines, she never 
alters her own running style just to 
pursue her~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was able to purely hone my running 
style, which I inherited from Sister 
Ryan~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's gotten a lot better.
Yeah, it's gotten a whole lot better.

text_block_list.text:
We were able to thoroughly instill into 
Mejiro Bright's body the perfect timing to 
make her move—neither too early nor too 
late.

Countermeasures are fully in place. 
However, if there was still anything to 
worry about—

"Even so, if there is anything that could 
hinder a good run, it would be the 
emergence of an unexpected, formidable 
rival..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I still can't see it... what my ideal 
running looks like. In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"If I can't run the way I want anyway, I 
might as well throw caution to the wind 
and..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No... They'll catch up to me like that. 
Besides, they told me there was no way I 
could finish the race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As expected... take the lead while 
watching behind. Or perhaps...
